SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
[RECRUITMENt CELL]
F. 6 (CM(S))/2026-SC(RC).
Date : October 12, 2026.
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications in the prescribed format are invited from the eligible
candidates, who are working in the High Courts and District Courts, for
filling up fifteen (15) tentative vacant posts of Court Master (Shorthand) in
the Supreme Court of India, on deputation basis.
The post of Court Master (Shorthand) is placed in Level 11 of Pay
Matrix, i.e., Rs.67,700 – Rs.2,08,700/- with initial basic pay of Rs.67,700/-
plus allowances, as admissible under the Rules.
Qualification and other eligibility conditions, as on ls: October, 2026

Knowledge of computer operation with a typing speed of
40 w.p.m, on computer;
Holding analogous post on regular basis; or minimum 5
years’ regular service in the cadre of Private
Secretary/Senior PA/PA/Senior Stenographer.
Age Requirement
The age of the candidate should not exceed 56 years, as on the
closing date of receipt of applications.
Selection Procedure
After receipt and scrutiny of the applications, the eligible candidates
will be subjected to Shorthand Skill Test, in English language, at the speed
of 120 w.p.m. with permissible five (05) per cent mistakes. The maximum
marks will be 100 and 50 marks will be minimum qualifying.marks. The
candidates, who qualify the said Test, will be subjected to interaction. The
1
ACRs/APARs of the last live years and vigilance clearance in respect of
the candidates, who qualify the Shorthand Skill Test, will be placed for
perusal at the time of interaction.
General Information
1.
2
The pay of official appointed on deputation will be fixed as per the
instructions issued by the Government of India, from time to time.
The period of deputation is, initially, fixed as one year, which is
extendable to three years. The period of deputation, including the
period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately
preceding this appointment in some other organization or
Department of the Central Government shall ordinarily not exceed
three years.
a
J. The last date for the eligible candidates to apply for the post of Court
Master (Shorthand), on deputation basis, is 27th October, 2026, and
the High Courts may send the applications latest by 31“ October,
2026, to this Registry. The applications of the eligible candidates,
who are working in the District Courts, may be routed and forwarded
through the concerned High Court.
4 The applications of the officials, who are eligible and whose services
can be spared in the event of selection, may be forwarded in the
prescribed proforma along with ACRs/APARs of the last five years
and vigilance clearance to the Recruitment Cell, Supreme Court of
India, Tilak Marg, New Delhi 110001. The scanned copies may be
sent at e-Mail I.D., recruitment.cell@sci.nic.in, for early scrutiny
of the applications. The applications, in the prescribed proforma, and
other documents, in original, may subsequently be sent, by post.
5 The applications not received through proper channel, without
supporting documents and photographs, unsigned and incomplete in
any manner, will not be considered and will stand rejected.

I Mahabir Singh I
